description: This file defines the 'LeaveEntitlementType' entity class used within the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'ohrm_leave_entitlement_type' database table and includes properties for id, name, and editable status, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementType
classes.description: Entity class representing different types of leave entitlement, mapped to the corresponding database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if the leave entitlement type is editable.

methods.name: setEditable
methods.description: Sets whether the leave entitlement type is editable.
